title: NASA's $125 million units mix-up
caption:
A spacecraft flew 670 million km to Mars and was lost to a missing unit label. 📏
One team sent thruster data in pound-force seconds, the other read it as newton-seconds, so every push was about 4.45 times bigger than navigation thought.
Metric or imperial: which side are you on?
sources: NASA, Mars Climate Orbiter Mishap Investigation Board Phase I Report (10 November 1999): ground software gave impulse in pound-force seconds instead of newton-seconds
NASA: Mars Climate Orbiter spacecraft cost about $125 million
